content: openid-client v6.8.5 (npm) is confirmed compatible with Cloudflare Workers/workerd via DeepWiki documentation, achieved through pure ESM architecture using only Fetch API and Web Crypto API. Depends on jose ^6.2.8 and oauth4webapi ^3.8.7, both also runtime-agnostic. Requires Node.js >=20 if used there. This makes it a viable candidate for EdgeOne Edge Functions, though bundle size (unpacked ~225KB + deps) may be a concern given the 5MB code package limit.
